statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of presyncope and palpitations
There is concern for underlying rhythm disturbances
There is clinical suspicion for sick sinus syndrome
There is clinical suspicion for unspecified cardiac arrhythmia (I49.9, I49.5)
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was billed
The diagnosis codes are I49.9 and I49.5
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is medically necessary to capture and characterize arrhythmic events in the ambulatory setting
